frequency_question: How often do structural economic friction and institutional pushback prevent threatened high-tariff actions from reaching implementation within the designated window?
membership_rule: Includes explicit threats or executive orders for broad, sector-specific tariffs exceeding 25% against G20 or major FTA partners where implementation was scheduled within 12 months. Excludes routine antidumping duties and narrow national security steel/aluminum tariffs that were fully implemented.
